sn41.3:2.4: The Brahmajālasutta ([dn1]()). It is referred to by name at [pli-tv-kd1:1.8.8]() and [vb17:21.3](), and by the list of views, numbered sixty-three at [snp3.6:42.1]() and sixty at [sn8.2:5.1]() = [thag21.1:9.1]().
sn41.3:4.13: According to the commentary, “substantialist view” (_sakkāyadiṭṭhi_) is the sixty-third view mentioned at [snp3.6:42.1]().
sn41.3:7.1: Citta consistently uses the honorific _ayya_ rather than the standard _āyasmā_.
sn41.3:8.8: His reason for leaving is not explained. Perhaps he did not wish to be seen as a favorite of the famous supporter. See similar occurrences at [sn41.4:6.9]() and [an3.126:7.5]()
